info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Reopens-v3-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Reopen API allows users to retrieve a list of support tickets that have been reopened. This endpoint serves as a crucial resource for support teams needing to track ongoing issues and ensure timely resolutions. Typical consumers include customer service agents and support analysts who utilize this information to manage customer inquiries effectively. By leveraging this API, organizations can improve their support tracking and enhance customer service quality.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to reopen a ticket that was previously closed. It is useful for situations where additional information has come to light or further action is required on the ticket.

requestBody.description: Request body for reopening a ticket. This body must contain the necessary data to identify and reopen the specified ticket.

200.description: Request completed successfully. Reopened ticket details are returned.

ListSupportTicketsReopensRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for reopening a ticket operation. It is expected to be a string value, typically containing the detailed information relevant to the ticket being reopened.

ListSupportTicketsReopensResponse_200.title: Ticket Reopen Response

status.description: Indicates whether the request to reopen the ticket was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the ticket reopening operation.

state.description: Current state of the ticket after the reopen operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the request outcome.

audit.description: Object containing audit information for the ticket reopening operation.

ListSupportTicketsReopensResponse_200.description: Response schema for the operation of reopening a ticket.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Name or identifier of the user who created the ticket.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the operation was performed by an automated system.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about who created the ticket and when.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
